nodes.text:
🟠HMPV often presents symptoms similar to (#RSV), making accurate diagnosis critical. 
Misdiagnosis can delay appropriate treatment or lead to unnecessary antibiotic use, thereby increasing the possibility of antibiotic resistance. 
#hMPV #China #India @CDCgov

nodes.text:
🟠Molecular testing offers a precise, rapid, and sensitive method for detecting #HMPV, reducing the diagnostic ambiguity often seen with conventional techniques like antigen-based assays or culture methods.
#hMPV #China #India @CDCgov

nodes.author: AponiaAnalytics
nodes.text:
🟠Improved diagnostics, especially #PCR technology, have significantly advanced the detection and management of #HMPV. 
These tools ensure precise diagnosis, reduce delays in treatment, and support comprehensive respiratory illness management.
#hMPV #China #India @CDCgov
